Name: Seasonal Outfits for Annetta of Cape Stardew - Full release
Author: LilietBorodina
Description:
[right][size=4]Seasonal outfits for Annetta from the wonderful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14635]Cape Stardew[/url] mod.
Made to be used with the gorgeous [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15519]Annetta Portraits and Vanilla Style Sprites[/url] by Lucidvisionsinc and Luan125gui.[/size][/right]


Includes outfits for all four seasons, indoor and outdoor variations. Essentially Annetta still only has one outfit... but she mixes and matches layers depending on the season!

The stockings, boots, shirt and warm vest go on in fall and winter, both indoors and outdoors.
The beret is for outdoors in all seasons.
The poncho is for outdoors in winter and spring.
The scarf is for fall and winter outdoors!
And of course the dress is for always ^^

Enjoy!


[size=5][center][b]MUST BE USED WITH THE [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15519]BASE PORTRAIT MOD[/url]﻿. ONLY CONTAINS THE OUTFIT OVERLAYS[/b][/center][/size]

Additional credits: the screenshots feature [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20754]Vintage Interface v2[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23337]Portraited Changing Skies[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12467]Font Settings[/url], and a number of other cosmetic mods I can't all remember and enumerate ^^;
